SELECT date_trunc('month', f.sale_date) m, count(*) lines, sum((o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL)::INT) li_line_null, sum((o.login_state='logged_in')::INT) li_lines, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL THEN f.receipt_id END) orders_affected, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL THEN f.receipt_id END) a, min(f.etl_loaded_at) mn, max(f.etl_loaded_at) mx
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
WHERE s.store_id=900 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_lines AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date,
         f.net_amount, f.member_key AS line_member_key, o.member_key AS order_member_key, o.login_state, p.category
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id = 900
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  count(*) n_lines,
  sum(CASE WHEN category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) test_lines,
  round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'),2) web_net,
  round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_member_key IS NOT NULL),2) member_net_order,
  round(sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_member_key IS NOT NULL),2) member_net_line,
  round(100.0*sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test' AND order_member_key IS NOT NULL)/sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'),3) share_order,
  round(100.0*sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test' AND line_member_key IS NOT NULL)/sum(net_amount) FILTER (WHERE category<>'ZZ Test'),3) share_line
FROM web_lines w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 8 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH w AS (
  SELECT CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd, f.net_amount, f.member_key lm, o.member_key om
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id AND o.status IN ('delivered','collected')
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'),
mine AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period p, sum(net_amount) net, sum((lm IS NOT NULL AND om IS NULL)::INT) lm_only, sum((lm IS NOT NULL AND om<>lm)::INT) mismatch FROM w JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=w.dd WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1),
rpt AS (SELECT d.fiscal_period p, sum(net_sales_before_returns) rnet FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11 GROUP BY 1)
SELECT mine.p, round(net,2) net, round(rnet,2) rnet, lm_only, mismatch FROM mine JOIN rpt USING (p) ORDER BY 1
